findings.description: The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. Although S3 provides baseline SSE-S3 encryption by default for new uploads, this configuration does not enforce an encryption setting or customer-managed KMS protection for objects in this archive.
The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. Its private ACL restricts access but does not enforce an encryption setting or customer-managed KMS protection for stored ledger exports.
The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. Versioning and logging do not enforce an encryption setting or customer-managed KMS protection for stored model artifacts.
The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption. The private ACL and versioning do not enforce an encryption setting or customer-managed KMS protection for runbook objects.

The object upload specifies no server-side encryption and its destination bucket has no encryption configuration. The upload is not configured to use or enforce a particular encryption method or KMS key for the vendor roster.
